question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH driver_points AS (
    SELECT ra.year, cs.constructor_id, c.name, MAX(r.points) as best_driver_points
    FROM results r
    JOIN constructor_standings cs ON r.race_id = cs.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    JOIN races ra ON cs.race_id = ra.race_id
    GROUP BY ra.year, cs.constructor_id, c.name
),
team_points AS (
    SELECT ra.year, cs.constructor_id, c.name, MAX(cs.points) as best_team_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    JOIN races ra ON cs.race_id = ra.race_id
    GROUP BY ra.year, cs.constructor_id, c.name
),
combined AS (
    SELECT dp.year, dp.constructor_id, dp.name, dp.best_driver_points, tp.best_team_points,
           dp.best_driver_points + tp.best_team_points as combined_points
    FROM driver_points dp
    JOIN team_points tp ON dp.year = tp.year AND dp.constructor_id = tp.constructor_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, name, combined_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY constructor_id ORDER BY combined_points DESC) as rn
    FROM combined
),
top_per_constructor AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, name, combined_points
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
ranked_top AS (
    SELECT year, constructor_id, name, combined_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY combined_points DESC) as overall_rank
    FROM top_per_constructor
)
SELECT year, constructor_id, name, combined_points
FROM ranked_top
WHERE overall_rank <= 3
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
